Our Apex Court in the case of TaeHung Packaging (BD) Limited and others vs Bangladesh and others, reported in 18 BLC (AD) 144, held: "The consistent views of this Division are that if any alternative remedy is available, the judicial review by the High Court Division in writ jurisdiction is not available with the exception that where the vires of a statutory provision is challenged or where the alternative remedy is not efficacious exercise of such power may be justified."
